title: Mother and Child in Mystic Night
description: A woman with long flowing brown hair sits on a wooden fence holding a baby to her breast in a surreal night landscape. She is surrounded by a glowing blue patterned rug with tarot cards, lit candles, a metal bucket, white birds, a raccoon, an owl, lotus flowers, and a large cracked moon dripping liquid from the starry sky.
prompt: A serene woman with long flowing brown hair sits on a wooden fence breastfeeding her baby in a dreamlike twilight landscape, surrounded by a glowing circular rug with tarot cards and lit candles, a metal bucket in front of her, white birds flying, a raccoon and owl nearby, large lotus flowers, twisted glowing trees, and a massive cracked full moon in the starry sky dripping white liquid, mystical and ethereal atmosphere
